name: ggml-speech
description: Speech-stack ggml flavour consumed by speech-cpp. 2026-10-26: every Adreno OpenCL prefill GEMM (q4_0, q4_1, q5_0, q5_1, q1_0, q4_K, q5_K, q6_K, iq4_nl, q8_0) sums its 32-product blocks in fp32 and recomputes a tile in fp32 when a block sum overflows, so a dot product past the fp16 range no longer comes back as inf (qvac-ext-ggml#132); merge 6eead4c5.

metal-fuse-mv-bias.description: Compile in the Q-variant mul_mv + ADD(bias) [+ ADD(residual)] fusion in ggml-metal. Off by default: empirically produces zero tokens on parakeet's EOU q8_0 joint network. Opt in only after Metal A/B-validating your model against the fused path.

webgpu.description: Enable the WebGPU GPU backend (ggml-webgpu on Google Dawn, driven natively through webgpu.h; no browser involved). Opt-in on every platform: Dawn targets Vulkan on Linux/Windows/Android and Metal on Apple. Dawn comes from microsoft/vcpkg's dawn port, which the consumer pins: route dawn, vulkan-headers, vulkan-utility-libraries and vcpkg-get-python-packages to microsoft/vcpkg in vcpkg-configuration.json, override dawn to 20260410.140140 (the newest version the speech-branch backend compiles against), and list dawn as a top-level dependency with default-features false so its Linux x11/gl/gles defaults stay off.
